definition: what my body did at the lowest point, measured

settled:
Two days without eating. Less than eight hours of sleep across seventy-two.

Being started from outside failed too. Someone else put food in front of me and I still could not eat, because what stopped me was stress nausea rather than not being able to begin.

My stress reached sixty on my own hundred-point scale, fifteen past being literally chased by a bear, and held there for a day.

A month later it was still at thirty.

title: The Worst Days Of The Break
